intro.line: Otaria, a few years after the Mirari went into the ground.
The Mirari twisted all that lived in the Krosan Forest into gross mockeries of their former selves.
Kamahl lives in Krosa now. He does not fight anymore. He listens to the trees.
Destruction is the work of an afternoon. Creation is the work of a lifetime.
In the Grand Coliseum, the Cabal has a new champion. Her touch is death. They call her Phage.

finale.line: Karona falls. Whatever was Akroma and whatever was Phage goes quiet with her.
Rise once more, so you may continue to destroy our enemies.
I made her to kill Phage. I never asked what she wanted. Neither did the Cabal.
Jeska wanted to go home. That was all she ever wanted.
As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred. Then she lost herself again in the joy of her victims' suffering.
Kamahl buries what is left in Krosa. The forest grows around it, slowly, the normal way.
Otaria rests. The Mirari is spent. For a while, nobody on Dominaria is anybody's god.

villainFinale.line: Karona stands over the Coliseum. Every eye in Otaria turns to her, and every heart.
They worship me. I do not know why. I do not know what I am.
An angel built from a grieving man's dream. A girl the Cabal broke and rebuilt.
I only ever wanted to know what I was. Nobody can tell me. So I will make them kneel until someone does.
Across Otaria, people kneel. None of them can answer her.

battles.title: Faces in the Crowd
battles.blurb: Ixidor and Nivea are illusionists who fight in the Grand Coliseum, and they are in love. They are also winning too much, and the Patriarch does not like surprises.

scene.line: The rabble likes them. Make sure they win, then book them for tomorrow.
Nivea says the crowd is louder tonight. I think they are louder for us.
Newcomers to Otaria find themselves at the bottom of the heap. In the pits, they at least have the chance to climb atop a heap of bodies.
Morph: play a creature face down as a 2/2 for three. Turn it up when they least expect it. Every face in the crowd is a secret.
Shaping reality is simply a matter of knowing where to apply pressure.

villainScene.line: The illusionists are popular. Popular is useful. Too popular is dangerous.
Family plots are so convenient.
Let them win tonight. Tomorrow, give the girl a real opponent.

after.line: Tomorrow, Nivea is given a real opponent. Ixidor is made to watch.
My past holds only pain and loss. I will conquer it by creating the perfect future.
Exiled to the desert, alone, Ixidor begins to dream of an angel. A beautiful one, with a sword, who hates the Cabal as much as he does.

hero.win: Did you hear them, Nivea? They were cheering.
hero.loss: Nivea, get out of the arena!
hero.half: Every face is a lie. Some lies bite.

battles.title: Kinship
battles.blurb: The Mirari's power is still bleeding out of Krosa, and the beasts it made are spilling into the Wirewood forest next door. The elves of Wirewood are few, but they fight together.

scene.line: No one in Wirewood understands what is happening. They just know it's unnatural—and coming from Krosa.
Most insects have been drawn to the Mirari. But all that remain in Wirewood are under my care.
HRRRRMMMMMM.
Even through the Mirari's voice, the elves still hear the call of their kinship.
Every elf makes every other elf stronger. A tribe is a card that counts its friends. Play them together.

villainScene.line: "The harder we press forward, the harder Krosa pushes us back." —Aven scout
HRRRM. Hungry. Was a deer once. Remember being a deer.
The blood of Krosa turns rational beings into primal forces.

after.line: No matter your strength, the Krosan Forest is stronger. No matter your speed, the Wirewood Forest is faster.

hero.low: Too big... they are too big...
hero.win: Go home, poor thing. If you still have one.
hero.loss: Fall back to the old trees!

battles.title: The Riptide Project
battles.blurb: A school of wizards on an island tried to recreate the slivers in a lab. They did. Now the slivers own the island, and Pemmin is the last researcher who hasn't been eaten.

scene.line: Taking the form of a junior researcher, the first sliver slipped out of Riptide.
The directors of the Riptide Project wanted instant results on the sliver experiments. They got their wish.
Right. Nobody panic. I am panicking for all of us.
Hold that thought.
Every sliver shares its ability with every other sliver. So kill the one that shares the best thing first.

villainScene.line: sssss.
sssss. SSSSSS.
There are a lot more of them now.
"Death couldn't contain the slivers. What made us think we could?" —Riptide Project researcher

after.line: The grounds of the Riptide Project are now populated only by slivers, broken beakers, and the lonely screeching of gulls.
I am putting in for a transfer.

hero.win: Write it down: we survived. Underline it.
hero.loss: If I wanted your opinion, I'd have told you what it was.

battles.title: The Untouchable
battles.blurb: Kamahl hears that the Cabal's champion has a face he knows. He leaves Krosa for the first time in years and walks into the Coliseum. Phage is waiting. She does not remember him.

scene.line: Jeska.
Who?
I do unto others as others have done unto me.
I did this to you. I know. Come home and let me make it right.
I can't hear them scream, but at least I don't have to listen to them beg.
If Phage hits you even once, you lose the game. Not life. The game. Never let her through.

villainScene.line: Their blood is the nectar that nourishes the Cabal.
The barbarian keeps saying a name. It makes my head hurt.
The Cabal says I was born in a vat. The Cabal is never wrong. I touch him, and the hurting stops.

after.line: Phage escapes into the Coliseum tunnels. For one heartbeat, at the end, she had looked at him like a sister.
Phage became both executioner and savior, helping others to the same rebirth she had found.

hero.low: Do not let her touch you...
hero.win: You are still in there. I saw it.
hero.half: Steel, Jeska. Remember? You had a temper of steel.

battles.title: The Angel of Wrath
battles.blurb: Out in the desert, Ixidor's dream has opened its eyes. Akroma was made for one purpose: destroy Phage. She starts with the Cabal's Coliseum, and Braids is running it tonight.

scene.line: Akroma asked for only one thing from her troops: unwavering, unconditional loyalty.
Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.
How cute. Does it do any other tricks?
Cycling: pay to discard a card and draw another. With Lightning Rift, every cycle is a bolt.
It is from Phage that this evil springs, and to her it shall return.

villainScene.line: I like goblins. They make funny little popping sounds when they die.
An angel who only wants one thing. I could have built that in an afternoon.
Finally, a use for that head of yours.

after.line: Ixidor had only to imagine their ruin and Akroma made it so.

hero.loss: I will not stay my hand.
hero.half: I feed my hatred to the righteous and they join my crusade.

villain.loss: She will find Phage anyway. That will be fun to watch.

battles.title: Goblin Tides
battles.blurb: The Order's soldiers hold the Daru Plains against everything Otaria throws at them. This week it is goblins. A lot of goblins. They have a commander now, which is worse.

scene.line: The tall, reedy grass of the Daru Plains rustles loudly in the winds, a perfect cover for any ambush.
Boys! I count four soldiers. Charge!
There are forty of us.
Boys! Count again!
Daru soldiers learned it's better to have a clean death from a sharp blade than to tangle with a goblin's rusted chains.
The commander makes more goblins every turn. Tokens count as creatures. Clear them before they snowball.

villainScene.line: Siege-Gang! Siege-Gang! We are a gang AND we siege!
Goblins resolve disputes by splitting everything straight down the middle.
Goblins' motivational techniques are crude, but effective.

after.line: They will be back tomorrow. They are always back tomorrow.

hero.half: One more volley. Then one more.

villain.low: Boys? Boys, where did everybody go?

battles.title: Angel and Untouchable
battles.blurb: Akroma finally finds Phage. The angel made to kill her, and the girl made to kill everything. Both were made by someone else. Neither knows it.

scene.line: Phage. I was made for you.
Everyone says that. Then they touch me.
My voice is justice. Clear and relentless.
You have a strange face, angel. Like someone dreamed you.
Protection from black means her black spells and creatures cannot touch me. Not even her.

villainScene.line: The barbarian said I had a brother. The angel says I have to die. Everyone knows what I am except me.
My voice is damnation, they tell me. Unyielding and certain.
I will touch the angel. Then maybe the hurting stops.

after.line: Neither one wins. At the moment their hands meet, Krosa answers, and the Mirari's last power pulls them together.
Angel and girl melt into one shape, crowned in light. Every eye in Otaria turns to look.

hero.low: Her touch... I can feel it through the steel...
hero.win: It is done. Why do I feel nothing?
hero.loss: This was all I was for...

villain.low: Stop... looking at me like that...

battles.title: Karona, False God
battles.blurb: Akroma and Phage are gone. In their place stands Karona, a god made of an angel and a girl, worshipped by everyone who sees her. Kamahl and Ixidor, the two men who made her halves, go to end it.

scene.line: Kneel.
Half of the Daru army kneels. So does half of the Cabal.
I made half of you. I am sorry.
I made the other half. I am sorrier.
There is no greater burden than choosing who to save.
She has both their decks, light and dark. Answer the angels and the Untouchable both. Nothing gets through.

villainScene.line: You. You are the dreamer. And you, the brother.
Tell me what I am. Everyone kneels, but nobody can tell me what I am.
Rise once more, so you may continue to destroy our enemies.

hero.start: For Jeska. For Akroma. For both of them.
hero.loss: Jeska... Akroma... I failed you both...

half.line: Akroma, if you are still in there, I am sorry I never asked what you wanted.
